# slack-token negatives: no non-comment line holds a hit.
too short: xoxb-FAKE-0000
unknown letter: xoxz-FAKE-0000000000-EXAMPLE
bare prefixes: xoxb- xoxp- xapp-1-
app token without its digit: xapp-FAKE-0000000000-EXAMPLE
rotated with a wrong inner prefix: xoxe.xoxa_FAKE-0000000000-EXAMPLE
inside a word: axoxb-FAKE-0000000000-EXAMPLE
